Unfortunately, we did not have a good experience at Westchester Animal Hospital.

We brought our puppy here on July 31 for his first veterinary examination because we were specifically instructed to do so.

A fecal test was supposedly performed, and we were told that everything was fine. However, our puppy was taken away from us during the examination, we did not see the fecal sample being collected or tested, and we were never provided with the actual fecal test results or any documentation confirming the results.

Only one day later, our puppy developed diarrhea, which progressively became much worse and included blood and a jelly-like/mucous substance. We had to take him to another veterinarian, where a new fecal test was performed in front of us. We were then told that his Coccidia infection had not been completely resolved and that he needed treatment, as well as another fecal test to confirm that the infection was gone.

The fact that another veterinarian identified an ongoing infection only a few days after our visit raises serious concerns about the examination and testing performed at Westchester. At the very least, we expected to receive the results of the fecal test and a clear explanation of our puppy’s condition and any necessary follow-up.

We are very disappointed with this experience and would strongly recommend that pet owners ask for copies of all test results and medical records before leaving.

I want to sincerely thank the entire clinic team for the exceptional care our dog, Taylor, received during these difficult days.

From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by how clean, organized, and well-equipped the clinic was, which gave us a lot of confidence from the very beginning. But beyond the facilities, what truly made the difference was the kindness of each and every person who cared for us.

They kept us informed at all times and never made us feel excluded from the process. They always allowed me to visit Taylor, which meant so much to me. Even before performing an endoscopy, they asked if I wanted to be present during the procedure, a gesture that demonstrates the respect and empathy with which they work. Ultimately, the endoscopy wasn't necessary, and upon discovering that Taylor had an intestinal obstruction, they made the decision to operate to help him.

Thank you for taking such good care of Taylor with such professionalism and dedication. In moments of worry and uncertainty, you gave us peace of mind and confidence. Seeing him recovering today and having him back with us fills us with immense joy.

We will always be grateful for everything you did for our little one. We would definitely recommend your clinic to anyone looking for a place where their pets are treated with excellence, love, and respect.

With much love and gratitude,

I brought my 2-year-old cat to this clinic because she was vomiting and had clear liquid coming from her behind. The staff said they would run tests to figure out what was going on. They performed several procedures but were unable to give me a clear diagnosis or explanation for her condition.

When I asked about finding out exactly what was wrong, I was told that would require an additional ultrasound. Despite that, I was reassured that my cat was stable and ready to go home around 8:30 p.m. I trusted their professional judgment. Less than two hours later, around 10 p.m., my cat passed away at home.

I’m devastated. I trusted that she was safe to bring home, and I wish I had been told how serious her condition might still have been or what warning signs to look for. I also noticed she had not been cleaned before discharge and still had dried diarrhea on her tail, which was upsetting to see after a full day of treatment.

We can't thank them enough for the care, love, and dedication they showed Chloe and us as a family. They called us constantly, kept us updated on every detail, and always showed patience and empathy.

We want to give a special thanks to technician Juan, José, and all the staff, especially Monika, who made this difficult process much easier.

Today, Chloe is back home, full of life, and we owe it all to them. 💕 A veterinary hospital we wholeheartedly recommend.
